 Order
% 21.04.2023 CRL.M.A.Nos.10582-83/2023 1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
Petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No.726/2022 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC registered at police station Punjabi Bagh, Delhi.
Admittedly, BA No.1054/2023 filed for anticipatory bail by husband of complainant is now coming up on 23.05.2023 wherein interim relief has been granted to the husband of complainant.
A bare perusal of the FIR would show primarily the allegations are against her husband.

4. The FIR was registered on 21.11.2022 and on 25.11.2022 the statement of victim under Section 164 Cr P C was recorded wherein she leveled allegation of rape against one person, who allegedly committed rape upon her at the instance of her husband.
The learned counsel for petitioner has referred to the MLC of the victim dated 02.02.2023 which also does not record of any allegation of rape by her husband's friend.

5. It is submitted primarily it is a matrimonial dispute and if one peruse the order dated 29.03.2023,
it notes there are chances of amicable settlement.

It is submitted petitioner is a known person in the Deepak vs Govt Of Nct Of Delhi Through S.H.O on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195719944/
1 family of the accused/husband and despite knowing him the victim never named him till 11.04.2023.
6.
